damping.stiffness_matrix: OpenSees initial stiffness Rayleigh term; zeroLength isolators created with -doRayleigh 1.

bouc_wen_update: OpenSees uniaxialMaterial BoucWen(alpha, ko, n, gamma, beta, Ao, deltaA, deltaNu, deltaEta); internal z is not exposed by eleResponse.

modeling_assumptions.frame: OpenSeesPy 2D elasticBeamColumn elements, 3 DOF per frame node.
modeling_assumptions.mass: Only specified lumped floor mass is assigned to horizontal floor DOFs; steel density is recorded but not added as self-mass.
modeling_assumptions.constraints: At each floor, equalDOF constrains horizontal displacement of side nodes to the center node; vertical translations and rotations remain independent.
modeling_assumptions.isolation: Three zeroLength elements connect fixed ground nodes to top isolator/base column nodes with BoucWen in local x and Elastic in local y.
modeling_assumptions.story_drift: Story 1 drift uses floor-1 diaphragm displacement minus average top-of-isolator displacement divided by story height.
modeling_assumptions.base_shear: Total base shear is the sum of horizontal BoucWen material resisting forces from the three isolator zeroLength elements.
modeling_assumptions.coordinates: UniformExcitation response is relative to the moving support in the frame x direction.
modeling_assumptions.bouc_wen_state: OpenSeesPy does not expose the internal z history through eleResponse; force-deformation histories are recorded.
